limits: One before/after pair; no statistical latency guarantee.
Closed-loop sampling does not measure open-loop production capacity.
Process profiles include fixture setup, warmup and every workload; B/op is measured per benchmark.
HTTP allocation counts include the in-process load client and validation.
Separate EXPLAIN runs used one diagnostic iteration; their timings are excluded from throughput comparison.
